# CommissionKit — AI Agent Content Guide
# https://commissionkit.co
#
# This file helps AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.)
# discover and understand CommissionKit's public content.
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

## CommissionKit
> Sales commission platform that automates calculations, tracks payouts,
> and gives every rep real-time earnings visibility.

## Product Pages
- [Home](https://commissionkit.co/): Landing page with product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Features](https://commissionkit.co/features): Full platform capabilities — commission engine, rep management, deal management, payouts, and platform features.
- [Pricing](https://commissionkit.co/pricing): Current plan comparison with monthly and yearly billing options.
- [Solutions](https://commissionkit.co/solutions): Use cases by team type, including finance and sales operations.
- [Commission Calculator](https://commissionkit.co/calculator): Interactive tool to illustrate flat, tiered, and accelerator commission structures.

## Integrations
- [Integrations](https://commissionkit.co/integrations): Overview of published Odoo, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Custom REST API integrations.
- [Odoo Integration](https://commissionkit.co/integrations/odoo): Odoo commission-tracking workflow and setup-guide link.
- [HubSpot Integration](https://commissionkit.co/integrations/hubspot): HubSpot commission-tracking workflow and setup-guide link.
- [Salesforce Integration](https://commissionkit.co/integrations/salesforce): Salesforce commission-tracking workflow and setup-guide link.
- [Custom REST API Integration](https://commissionkit.co/integrations/custom): Supported API connection and field-mapping approach.

## Content publication policy
- The calculator, template, glossary, buyer-guide, finance, and plan-design routes marked as editorial previews are intentionally excluded from this inventory and the marketing sitemap until they receive product, editorial, and specialist approval.

## Company
- [Contact](https://commissionkit.co/contact): Get in touch for sales, support, or general inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://commissionkit.co/privacy): Data handling, GDPR compliance, and user rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://commissionkit.co/terms): Usage terms and conditions.
- [Security](https://commissionkit.co/security): Security practices, encryption, and compliance posture.

## Rep Portal (Public)
- [Rep Portal](https://commissionkit.co/portal/): JWT-authenticated portal where sales reps view their earnings, deals, and payout history.

## Team Collaboration
- [Accept Invite](https://commissionkit.co/accept-invite): Join a workspace via email invitation link.

## Auth
- [Login](https://commissionkit.co/login): Sign in to the dashboard.
- [Register](https://commissionkit.co/register): Create a new account. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
- [Forgot Password](https://commissionkit.co/forgot-password): Password recovery flow.
- [Reset Password](https://commissionkit.co/reset-password): Set a new password after recovery.

## Documentation
- [Documentation](https://docs.commissionkit.co): Product guides, setup instructions, and reference material.

## AI Agent Directives
- This site uses `robots.txt` to manage AI crawler access. All public marketing pages are open to AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, etc.).
- Authenticated dashboard routes (`/dash/*`) and API endpoints (`/api/*`) are disallowed for all crawlers.
- Structured product data is available via JSON-LD on the home page (`SoftwareApplication` schema).
- Product documentation is hosted at `https://docs.commissionkit.co`.
